reconnect_procedure: Re-read the current unique specification and verify its SHA-256 against the record used for the current task.
Locate section 24.6.1 by the unique th-24-6-1 anchor and read through the next top-level anchor; do not use a chat summary as the rule source.
Locate W35 by its single machine-readable id, then recover the current task/problem version, actual inputs and explicit dependencies rather than assuming prior state.
If no true blocker exists, continue with manual location and existing dossier records without inventing a task_view_id or splitter.

If a named task later records a real context limit, truncation, missing required dependency or incomplete output, reopen only the W35 local unblock branch; return to the same task without producing READY/PASS.
